There's a character in this game that fires homing rockets and a kamehameha wave with a 1 second cooldown. On it's own that sounds incredibly unbalanced, but then you find out that every character is like this in their own way. For instance, One of the simpler characters is a guy with a sword and shield. That's it, just a sword and shield. The problem is that he can block almost anything (I don't think he can block poison.) so if you have the reflexes you can block and counter anything your opponents throw at you and take stocks really fast. All of the characters have something that makes them special and able to compete with the rest. (Besides roller skating girl in my opinion, because of how most map layouts are it's hard to use her ability well.) I really like how fast paced the combat is and it's fun to mess with people with characters like Owl, Rabbit, and Ice Man. The only problem I have with this game is the boss fights. They're too long for how challenging they are, (Especially the Samurai and Puppeteer) I enjoyed the Ninja because you have a fair amount of time to react. The Bee fight was also fine, you just have to rush him as soon as he spawns if you don't want to take too much damage from his barrages. The Afro Samurai was annoying. Unlike the Ninja he's very spams out his sword beams so much in such a short period of time you can't really react, so if he's not going to be fair on the timing I think he should do the same routine every fight after getting hit. The same number of beams, in the same places every time you fight him. The Cactus is fine, you should be able to roll past him most of the time. The Puppeteer should be removed and is the worst fight by far. There is no pattern, there is no special scripted moments, he just has two more puppets and a lot of invincibility frames and it's beyond annoying. He's insufferable, I feel like I should get a costume for every character by beating that annoying waste of space once. (As of this review I have not fought the Poison so I can't say anything about her fight here.) Overall: 8/10

このショートカットキーはゲームではよくあるショートカットキーなので「フルスクリーンで映らないのならウィンドウモードにこのショートカットキーで変更すれば、音は出てるし、いけるんじゃないか？」とダメ元で切り替えたら解決しましたが、オプション画面を開くとモードはフルスクリーンのままになっているので、それをオフにし、好みの解像度に変更しましょう。

攻撃は通常攻撃と特殊攻撃(？)の二種類。攻撃のモーション次第ですが、自分で操作できる方向は縦横で斜め入力が今のところ操作したキャラではできるキャラがいません。

そしてなぜ死にゲーかと言うと、アーケードモードの難易度イージーをやり、操作した、または対戦して見たキャラの攻撃で近接系は大体一撃当たれば死にます。

遠距離系は相手が近距離系の攻撃なら逃げ回って通常攻撃で削るか、隙を突いて特殊技を当ててワンパンを狙うことになりました。ただし、これは自分が使ったキャラが通常攻撃は銃撃(？)、特殊技はショットガンだったためなので全キャラ共通のセオリーというわけではありません。

といった具合にキャラバランスは悪いですし、フルスクリーンだと画面出力がされない等の問題がありましたが、セール価格の249円で買った自分はどうCPUをワンパンするか試行錯誤して楽しみました。

Gotta say that, I really enjoyed this game. The gameplay is pretty fast-paced and fun, the characters all have their own unique play-styles that changes the game up a bit, the pixel art is really nice to look at, and there's a decent amount of content. There are a couple of flaws, though.

For one, the game's pretty unbalanced as some characters have attacks that can easily kill someone in one hit, while others have attacks that will take a couple of hits before it can kill someone. This can make the Arcade mode pretty annoying at times for some playable characters as you don't really have a lot of lifes on matches in Arcade mode and some attacks can kill you instantly.

Another issue is that the audio in the game isn't very good. The soundtrack could use a little bit more work as it consists of small and short tunes that wouldn't even work as ringtones, and the sound effects are pretty bland.

Despite those issues, though, I still really enjoyed this game. It's no Super Smash Brothers by any means, but it's still a neat, little game to play with friends. Plus, it's only 5$, so you won't be spending too much on this game.
